name: @forgeax/engine-audio-webaudio
description: Host-owned ForgeAX Web Audio consumer: decode cache, pending playback, AudioContext, buses, source nodes, and cleanup.

bundle-size.reason: Host Web Audio consumer is covered by package tests; no standalone player bundle is emitted

fps.reason: library package; fps is reported by apps that consume the audio tick system in their render loop

bench.reason: opt-in native browser DSP/control benchmark via pnpm bench; hardware measurements are preserved with source hashes rather than used as a cross-run CI threshold

gate.reason: no package-level binary gate; test surface coverage runs as part of pnpm test:unit + tsc -b

spike-report.reason: not a spike package; this is a production MVP per plan-strategy D-1 (dual-package split)
